checks: Public catalog has seven verified sources, four mixed defaults and no account dependency
Phone client accepts actual default-board and EU search responses without a catalog-only region field
Strict source normalization accepts board and direct-posting links without arbitrary fetch URLs
Invalid filters, source counts and cursor parameters are rejected before provider traffic
Public requests ignore account credentials and never persist or forward personal search terms
Provider identities, plain text, unknown country and remote evidence remain distinct
Keyword AND, location text and remote-only filters operate on public metadata
Latin keywords start at a word boundary instead of matching inside unrelated titles
Keyword prefixes, case, accents and literal skill punctuation remain searchable
Arabic and continuous-script searches keep substring matching at mixed-script boundaries
All keywords can span public metadata while location retains literal substring matching
Shared board caching survives handler recreation and preserves original observation time
Stable cursors page a fair multi-source result without duplicates and bind the original filters
Cursors from the previous substring-matching rule require a fresh search
Refreshing a source invalidates old cursors instead of silently mixing snapshots
A failed source retains visibly stale facts while successful sources remain current
Expired stale data and complete source failures are unavailable rather than an empty successful search
A missing board clears cached vacancies and the negative cooldown suppresses repeated requests
Provider Retry-After is honored while cached timestamps remain unchanged
D1 leases coalesce concurrent isolates without process-local queues
Expired claims recover and late completions cannot overwrite a newer successful snapshot
Malformed provider data is attributed and never becomes a successful empty board
Job-count and UTF-8 cache-byte limits remain below a D1 row and disclose partial coverage
A later temporary Lever failure preserves validated pages as partial and recovers after cooldown
The unchanged source deadline keeps completed Lever pages and starts no over-budget page
A later Lever rate limit keeps validated jobs while honoring the complete Retry-After interval
A removed Lever board never keeps an earlier page as a partial current result
A later Lever body disconnect keeps validated jobs and permits a later complete refresh
A real later-page body timeout cancels the reader while preserving completed Lever pages
A later-page shared budget denial preserves jobs without an extra GET or early retry
A malformed later Lever page is not salvaged as a fresh prefix
A redirected later Lever page is not salvaged as a fresh prefix
A new partial snapshot invalidates old cursors and never mixes an old cached tail
A long provider cooldown outlives freshness and stale retention without sliding or new traffic
Lever pages are bounded to five public GETs and 500 normalized postings
Wrong MIME type releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Oversized declared body releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Invalid declared body length releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Header rejection preserves its error when transport cleanup is reject
Header rejection preserves its error when transport cleanup is pending
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for resolve cleanup
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for reject cleanup
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for pending cleanup
A body-rejection cooldown permits a clean successful refresh without false empty-cache success
Redirects and oversized responses are refused without following untrusted destinations
A response arriving after timeout releases its unread body without changing the timeout outcome
A stalled response body is cancelled within the bounded provider timeout
Client and missing-IP request budgets are shared, atomic and return Retry-After
Custom negative cache capacity and fetch budgets reserve service for the catalog
Concurrent custom source admission cannot exceed the durable cache quota
Security counters expire without storing raw IPs or requiring an applicant account
Actual bundled workerd runs eight public discovery requests with real D1 and no account or R2
scope: Actual local D1 SQL concurrency/quotas/cache with production discovery handler and synthetic bounded provider GETs; actual bundled workerd public API requests. Every successful response is parsed by the phone client model. Real public source availability is recorded separately.
